data.Q: Why does the vine refuse to rule the trees?
data.A: The vine will not give up its wine that cheers gods and humans.
data.wrong_answer: Because the trees already ask the thornbush to be king.

data.Q: Whom do all the trees ask to be their king?
What would the vine give up to rule the trees?
After the vine answers, what do all the trees do next?
data.A: All the trees speak to the thornbush to be their king.
data.wrong_answer: The vine gives up its wine.
